mapper.insert: INSERT INTO organization_member (organization_id, user_id, role_code, status, joined_at, created_at) VALUES (#{organizationId}, #{userId}, #{roleCode}, 'ACTIVE', #{joinedAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM organization_member WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY joined_at, id
SELECT FROM organization_member WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY organization_id, id
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM organization_member WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
